arxiv-1601-02263.title: The Asymptotic Expansion of Kummer Functions for Large Values of the 𝒂 \boldsymbol{a} -Parameter, and Remarks on a Paper by Olver This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Orthogonal Polynomials, Special Functions and Applications. The full collection is available at http://www.emis.de/jo
arxiv-1601-02263.creator: Hans VOLKMER
arxiv-1601-02263.description: Abstract It is shown that a known asymptotic expansion of the Kummer function U ⁡ ( a , b , z ) U(a,b,z) as a a tends to infinity is valid for z z on the full Riemann surface of the logarithm. A corresponding result is also proved in a more general setting considered by Olver (1956).

arxiv-1808-01889.title: Block-Separation of Variables: a Form of Partial Separation for Natural Hamiltonians
arxiv-1808-01889.creator: Claudia Maria CHANU and Giovanni RASTELLI
arxiv-1808-01889.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Claudia Maria CHANU and Giovanni RASTELLI. We study twisted products H = α r ​ H r H=\alpha^{r}H_{r} of natural autonomous Hamiltonians H r H_{r} , each one depending on a separate set, called here separate r r -block, of variables.

arxiv-2112-09149.title: Quenched randomness, thermal fluctuations and reentrant superconductivity: application to UTe 2
arxiv-2112-09149.creator: Yue Yu, S. Raghu
arxiv-2112-09149.description: Abstract Reentrant superconductivity has been observed in the candidate spin-triplet superconductor UTe 2 as a function of the magnetic field applied along the hard axis. Resistivity measurements have shown, a broadened superconducting transition appears near the minimal T c T_{c} , highlighting the importance of superconducting fluctuations in this regime.

arxiv-2501-13656.title: A search for close binary systems in the SALT survey of hydrogen-deficient stars using TESS
arxiv-2501-13656.creator: E. J. Snowdon, C. S. Jeffery, S. Schlagenhauf, M. Dorsch
arxiv-2501-13656.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by E. J. Snowdon, C. S. Jeffery, S. Schlagenhauf, M. Dorsch. The TESS periodograms of the SALT survey catalogue of hydrogen-deficient stars were searched for evidence of short-period variability. Periodic light curve variations were identified in 16 stars out of 153 catalogue objects, of which 10 were false positives. From the remaining 6 identified variables, Ton S 415 is a known close binary system and the sixth close binary containing a hydrogen-deficient hot subdwarf.

arxiv-2502-01410.title: Finite convergence and minimizer extraction in moment relaxations with correlative sparsity
arxiv-2502-01410.creator: Giovanni Fantuzzi 1, Federico Fuentes 2
arxiv-2502-01410.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Giovanni Fantuzzi 1, Federico Fuentes 2. We identify a new sufficient condition for the finite convergence of moment relaxations of polynomial optimization problems with correlative sparsity. This condition, which follows from a solution to a correlatively sparse version of the classical truncated moment problem, requires that certain moment matrices admit a flat extension and that the variable cliques underpinning the relaxation satisfy a ‘running intersection’ property.

arxiv-2504-05081.title: The Curse of CoT : On the Limitations of Chain-of-Thought in In-Context Learning
arxiv-2504-05081.creator: Tianshi Zheng, Yixiang Chen, Chengxi Li, Chunyang Li, Qing Zong, Haochen Shi, Baixuan Xu, Yangqiu Song, Ginny Y. Wong, Simon See
arxiv-2504-05081.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tianshi Zheng, Yixiang Chen, Chengxi Li, Chunyang Li, Qing Zong, Haochen Shi, Baixuan Xu, Yangqiu Song, Ginny Y. Wong, Simon See. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has been widely recognized for its ability to enhance reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs) through the generation of explicit explanatory rationales. However, our study reveals a surprising contradiction to this prevailing perspective.

arxiv-2510-05886.title: acia-workflows: Automated Single-cell Imaging Analysis for Scalable and Deep Learning-based Live-cell Imaging Analysis Workflows
arxiv-2510-05886.creator: Johannes Seiffarth, Keitaro Kasahara, Michelle Bund, Benita Lückel, Richard D. Paul, Matthias Pesch, Lennart Witting, Michael Bott, Dietrich Kohlheyer, Katharina Nöh
arxiv-2510-05886.description: Abstract Summary Live-cell imaging (LCI) technology enables the detailed spatio-temporal characterization of living cells at the single-cell level, which is critical for advancing research in the life sciences, from biomedical applications to bioprocessing. High-throughput setups with tens to hundreds of parallel cell cultivations offer the potential for robust and reproducible insights.

britannica-1911-erckmann-chatrian.title: Erckmann-Chatrian (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-erckmann-chatrian.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-erckmann-chatrian.description: Article 'Erckmann-Chatrian' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 9), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. writers whose collaboration made their work that of, so to speak, one personality. Émile Erckmann (1822–1899) was born on the 20th of May 1822 at Phalsbourg, and Louis Gratien Charles Alexandre Chatrian (1826–1890) on the 18th of December 1826 at Soldatenthal, Lorraine. In 1847 they began to write together, and continued doing so till 1889. Chatrian died in 1890 at Villemomble near Paris, and Erckmann at Lunéville in 1899.

pmc-10740842.title: Evaluation of the Composition of the Cholesterol, Tocopherols, β-Carotene and Fatty Acids Profile of the Liver Tissue of Male Water Buffaloes (Bubalus bubalis) Managed in Different Ecosystems of the Eastern Amazon
pmc-10740842.creator: Laurena Silva Rodrigues, Jamile Andrea Rodrigues da Silva, José de Brito Lourenço-Júnior, André Guimarães Maciel e Silva, Thomaz Cyro Guimarães de Carvalho Rodrigues, Welligton Conceição da Silva, Thiago Carvalho da Silva, Vinicius Costa Gomes de Castro, Cristina Mateus Alfaia, André Martinho de Alm
pmc-10740842.description: Simple SummaryThis study evaluated the influence of Amazonian ecosystems, during the dry and rainy seasons, on the composition of the livers of water buffaloes (Bubalus bubalis) raised in the Eastern Amazon in extensive and intensive systems. The results showed that the total lipid content was affected by location and season.

pmc-11625566.title: Regulation of cochlear hair cell function by intracellular calcium stores
pmc-11625566.creator: Ghanshyam P. Sinha, Gregory I. Frolenkov
pmc-11625566.description: IntroductionMammalian hearing depends on the dual mechanosensory and motor functions of cochlear hair cells. Both these functions may be regulated by Ca2+ release from intracellular stores. However, it is still unclear how exactly intracellular Ca2+ release may affect either hair cell mechano-electrical transduction (MET) or prestin-dependent electromotility in outer hair cells (OHCs).

pmc-11665148.title: A gigantic intraosseous and dural-based calvarial metastatic follicular thyroid carcinoma: illustrative case
pmc-11665148.creator: Anthony T. Lee, Kunal P. Raygor, Noah M. Nichols, Phiroz E. Tarapore
pmc-11665148.description: BACKGROUNDMetastatic follicular thyroid carcinoma to the central nervous system (CNS), including the skull and dura, is exceedingly rare.OBSERVATIONSThe authors present the case of a gigantic, intraosseous, dural-based follicular thyroid carcinoma, highlighting the operative strategy for this mass. They also provide a literature review of CNS metastases of differentiated thyroid carcinoma.

pmc-12852886.title: SkinAttn-Net: a multi-level attention-based network for skin lesion segmentation
pmc-12852886.creator: Ömer Faruk Söylemez
pmc-12852886.description: Accurate segmentation of skin lesions is essential for automated melanoma detection and dermoscopic image analysis. Traditional convolutional networks often fail to capture both fine-grained lesion boundaries and global contextual information. We porpose SkinAttn-Net, a stage-aware segmentation framework that integrates complementary attention mechanisms according to the functional role of each network component.

pmc-13084912.title: Oncolytic adenovirus in combination with PD-L1-targeted radioimmunotherapy exerts synergistic antitumor effect against pancreatic cancer
pmc-13084912.creator: A-Rum Yoon, Seungyoun Kim, Ji Yi, Javeria Zaheer, Hyeongi Kim, Je Hyeon Seo, Jinwoo Hong, Jeongwon Lee, Hyeju Jeong, Joycie Shanmugiah, Ju Hee Kim, In-Wook Kim, Jin Su Kim, Chae-Ok Yun
pmc-13084912.description: BackgroundTo date, no radioimmunotherapy (RIT) regimen has been approved by US Food and Drug Administration for the treatment of pancreatic cancers. Highly desmoplastic and immune-desert phenotypes of pancreatic cancer remain two major hurdles that attenuate the efficacy of conventional treatment (radiotherapy and chemotherapy) and immunotherapeutic (immune checkpoint inhibitors and chimeric antigen receptor T cells).

pmc-13142647.title: Pulseless Electrical Activity Arrest in End-Stage Heart Failure Complicated by Cocaine-Associated Cardiotoxicity and Cerebellar Infarction: A Post-resuscitation Diagnostic Pitfall
pmc-13142647.creator: Cristina Suarez Chiriboga, Roxana Lazarescu
pmc-13142647.description: Pulseless electrical activity (PEA) arrest in patients with end-stage heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) most commonly reflects profound circulatory collapse rather than a primary arrhythmogenic event. Although post-resuscitation encephalopathy often prompts early neurologic prognostication, myocardial dysfunction and refractory shock frequently dominate outcomes in this population.

uslaw-usc-t40-s527.title: 40 U.S.C. § 527 — Abandonment, destruction, or donation of property
uslaw-usc-t40-s527.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t40-s527.description: United States Code, Title 40 (Public Buildings, Property, And Works); Chapter 5 (Property Management); Subchapter II (Use Of Property). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Administrator of General Services may authorize the abandonment or destruction of property, or the donation of property to a public body, if— (1) the property has no commercial value; or (2) the estimated cost of continued care.
